title: Doesn’t Flow As Well
text: Doesn’t Flow As Well. This is my second backflow incense holder. This one doesn’t seem to flow as well as my smaller one. It comes with a ton of backflow cones, unfortunately, they all just kind of smell like burning. Doesn’t have a nice smell. I typically prefer a Nag Champa type smell and these are just a generic cheap incensy smell. It is also a little bit difficult to get the cone onto the top and have the holes lineup perfectly. The mat under the bottom is like a round mouse pad, which confuses me a bit.
